FIELD INCIDENT REPORT
Form FIR-1 (rev. 2026-03)
OPERATOR
Northline Gas Transmission Ltd.
REPORTED BY
Area supervisor
RECEIVED VIA
Phone call (on-call write-up)
DESCRIPTION OF THE EVENT (what happened, when, where, who, what was released)
Hey, just got a call from Jamie down at Gravenhurst station. Around 4:30 PM today they found a
sweet crude release inside the fence. One guy says it's about 1.2 cubic, another thinks closer to
2. Looks like some construction gear might've clipped something-no idea yet. Temps have been
swinging wild lately too, not sure if that's a factor. No meter reading yet, but nothing left the
yard. That's all I've got for now.
-Mike, Area Supervisor
SUPERVISOR REVIEW
